segments.text:
V. 28.
The country of Gergeſenes—Or of the Gadarenes. Gergeſa and Gadara were Towns near each other. Hence the Country between them took its Name, ſometimes from the one, ſometimes from the other. There met him two demoniacs—St. Mark and St. Luke mention only one, who was probably the fiercer of the two, and the Perſon who ſpoke to our LORD firſt. But this is no way inconſiſtent with the Account which St. Matthew gives. The tombs— Doubtleſs thoſe malevolent Spirits love ſuch Tokens of Death and Deſtruction. Tombs were uſually in thoſe Days in deſart Places, at a Diſtance from Towns, and were often made in the Sides of Caves, in the Rocks and Mountains. No one could paſs—Safely.
